text:
maya: Pushing a small design PR tonight for the onboarding banner + compact checklist on the dashboard. Want quick takes before the design review.
liam: Link? Prefer inline banner vs modal on desktop. Modals kill context and people close them.
olivia: Inline sounds good. Key asks: dismissible, persisted per user, and keyboard accessible. Also CTA contrast low on the current artboard (2.9:1) 1: fail for normal text.
maya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/onboarding-mini (mock). Plan: banner at top of home dashboard, collapsed by default after first view, expand to a right side panel for the steps.
jamie: On the panel UX: don't trap focus (not a modal) but ensure each step is focusable and theres a clear focus indicator. Use aria-live for completion messages so SR users get feedback.
design: Copy options: A: "Start your first project" B: "Get started in 5 minutes". Suggest microcopy under CTA: "Try with sample data". Keep labels very short: "Create API key", "Run sample", "Inspect logs".
aria: For sample projects, recommend two starter templates: "Support assistant" (low-cost, good for chat demos) and "Docs search" (higher token usage, shows embeddings). Add tiny badges: "low-cost" / "interactive".
sam: Suggest showing curl + node snippets inline. Also show estimated token cost and sample latency under each template so users set expectations.
liam: Question about progress indicator: top nav badge vs inline progress meter. I like a subtle dot on the user avatar that expands to the full checklist if clicked. Keeps clutter low.
olivia: Accessibility nit: ensure the CTA is not only color-reliant. Add an icon and underline on focus. Also include an accessible label that reads the remaining steps count.
maya: Example JS snippet for the starter template (short):
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $API_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-2', prompt: 'Hello from sample project' })
})
  .then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```
jamie: QA checklist for handoff: keyboard order, visible focus, aria labels on each interactive item, high contrast theme test, screen reader walkthrough. Run axe + NVDA/VoiceOver smoke test.
design: I'll update Figma with banner collapsed/expanded states, side panel flow, and both CTA color variants (default + high contrast). Adding copy variants now.
aria: I'll draft two README markdowns for the sample projects: starter-bot.md and docs-search.md. Each will have estimated tokens, expected latency, and a note about cost tradeoffs.
onboarding-bot: automation: when user completes last step emit event onboarding.completed and set user flag onboarding.shown=false to stop showing the banner.
maya: Action list: design updates figma (design); readmes (aria); snippets + sample payload (sam/liam); analytics hook + event (jamie). Review scheduled 9:30 AM PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
